units.rawText: One week later, the sharp, shrill blast of a whistle once again echoes through all of Krasno.
units.displayText: One week later, the sharp, shrill blast of a whistle once again echoes through all of Krasno.

spans.text: One week later, the sharp, shrill blast of a whistle once again echoes through all of Krasno.

units.rawText: Countless soldiers rush out of their barracks in a panic. Some limp along while some scramble on the ground. Even some of the Dolls are stumbling over their feet.
units.displayText: Countless soldiers rush out of their barracks in a panic. Some limp along while some scramble on the ground. Even some of the Dolls are stumbling over their feet.

spans.text: Countless soldiers rush out of their barracks in a panic. Some limp along while some scramble on the ground. Even some of the Dolls are stumbling over their feet.

units.rawText: Regardless, all of them are doing their best to reach the training yard, as though being late for even a single second will bring a disaster down upon their heads.
units.displayText: Regardless, all of them are doing their best to reach the training yard, as though being late for even a single second will bring a disaster down upon their heads.

spans.text: Regardless, all of them are doing their best to reach the training yard, as though being late for even a single second will bring a disaster down upon their heads.

units.rawText: I gave you one minute, but even the worst among you only took 45 seconds to reach here. Looks like the punishment over the past few days left an impression.
units.displayText: I gave you one minute, but even the worst among you only took 45 seconds to reach here. Looks like the punishment over the past few days left an impression.

spans.text: I gave you one minute, but even the worst among you only took 45 seconds to reach here. Looks like the punishment over the past few days left an impression.

units.rawText: Perhaps I should be grateful that your stupidity isn't crippling. We'll skip the disciplinary phase today and look back on our training over the past week.
units.displayText: Perhaps I should be grateful that your stupidity isn't crippling. We'll skip the disciplinary phase today and look back on our training over the past week.

spans.text: Perhaps I should be grateful that your stupidity isn't crippling. We'll skip the disciplinary phase today and look back on our training over the past week.

units.rawText: Erwin, step forward!
units.displayText: Erwin, step forward!

spans.text: Erwin, step forward!

units.rawText: Sir, yes, sir!
units.displayText: Sir, yes, sir!

spans.text: Sir, yes, sir!

units.rawText: Erwin takes a step forward almost as soon as Python calls his name.
units.displayText: Erwin takes a step forward almost as soon as Python calls his name.

spans.text: Erwin takes a step forward almost as soon as Python calls his name.

units.rawText: Turn around and face your teammates, then tell them about how they did.
units.displayText: Turn around and face your teammates, then tell them about how they did.

spans.text: Turn around and face your teammates, then tell them about how they did.

units.rawText: Sir! Over the course of this week's training, we have three excellents, two goods, one pass and five terribles.
units.displayText: Sir! Over the course of this week's training, we have three excellents, two goods, one pass and five terribles.

spans.text: Sir! Over the course of this week's training, we have three excellents, two goods, one pass and five terribles.

units.rawText: Three excellents, two goods, one pass and five terribles?
units.displayText: Three excellents, two goods, one pass and five terribles?

spans.text: Three excellents, two goods, one pass and five terribles?

units.rawText: Wrong! You got three passes and eight terribles, you pack of morons.
units.displayText: Wrong! You got three passes and eight terribles, you pack of morons.

spans.text: Wrong! You got three passes and eight terribles, you pack of morons.

units.rawText: Who the hell are you? You're the elite, the cream of the crop, hand-picked from the various divisions within the military.
units.displayText: Who the hell are you? You're the elite, the cream of the crop, hand-picked from the various divisions within the military.

spans.text: Who the hell are you? You're the elite, the cream of the crop, hand-picked from the various divisions within the military.

units.rawText: <size=40>Sir, I was wrong, sir!</size>
units.displayText: Sir, I was wrong, sir!

spans.text: Sir, I was wrong, sir!

units.rawText: If you're wrong, then correct your mistake! Do I need to teach you something that even grade schoolers know?
units.displayText: If you're wrong, then correct your mistake! Do I need to teach you something that even grade schoolers know?

spans.text: If you're wrong, then correct your mistake! Do I need to teach you something that even grade schoolers know?

units.rawText: Sir, we have three passes and eight terribles! As platoon leader, I have no excuse for this! Please punish me, sir!
units.displayText: Sir, we have three passes and eight terribles! As platoon leader, I have no excuse for this! Please punish me, sir!

spans.text: Sir, we have three passes and eight terribles! As platoon leader, I have no excuse for this! Please punish me, sir!

units.rawText: Stand aside, don't think asking for punishment is going to earn any leniency from me. You'll get everything you deserve.
units.displayText: Stand aside, don't think asking for punishment is going to earn any leniency from me. You'll get everything you deserve.

spans.text: Stand aside, don't think asking for punishment is going to earn any leniency from me. You'll get everything you deserve.

units.rawText: Evelyn!
units.displayText: Evelyn!

spans.text: Evelyn!

units.rawText: Sir, yes, sir!
units.displayText: Sir, yes, sir!

spans.text: Sir, yes, sir!

units.rawText: Report your results.
units.displayText: Report your results.

spans.text: Report your results.

units.rawText: Sir, over the course of this week's training, we have three full marks, two passes, and six terribles!
units.displayText: Sir, over the course of this week's training, we have three full marks, two passes, and six terribles!

spans.text: Sir, over the course of this week's training, we have three full marks, two passes, and six terribles!

units.rawText: WRONG! You also have three passes and eight terribles! I thought you were slightly less dim than Erwin, but I see that's wishful thinking.
units.displayText: WRONG! You also have three passes and eight terribles! I thought you were slightly less dim than Erwin, but I see that's wishful thinking.

spans.text: WRONG! You also have three passes and eight terribles! I thought you were slightly less dim than Erwin, but I see that's wishful thinking.

units.rawText: As Dolls, how could you hold yourselves to human standards? In that case, why don't I request another batch of human troops? It's the same thing, after all.
units.displayText: As Dolls, how could you hold yourselves to human standards? In that case, why don't I request another batch of human troops? It's the same thing, after all.

spans.text: As Dolls, how could you hold yourselves to human standards? In that case, why don't I request another batch of human troops? It's the same thing, after all.

units.rawText: Sir, according to the tactical training assessment guidelines issued by the military, we did obtain three full marks, two passes, and six terribles!
units.displayText: Sir, according to the tactical training assessment guidelines issued by the military, we did obtain three full marks, two passes, and six terribles!

spans.text: Sir, according to the tactical training assessment guidelines issued by the military, we did obtain three full marks, two passes, and six terribles!

units.rawText: Are you questioning my judgment!?
units.displayText: Are you questioning my judgment!?

spans.text: Are you questioning my judgment!?

units.rawText: Sir, no I am not, sir! May I know if you have amended the assessment guidelines, sir?
units.displayText: Sir, no I am not, sir! May I know if you have amended the assessment guidelines, sir?

spans.text: Sir, no I am not, sir! May I know if you have amended the assessment guidelines, sir?

units.rawText: I told you on the very first day that my word is law.
units.displayText: I told you on the very first day that my word is law.

spans.text: I told you on the very first day that my word is law.

units.rawText: Sir, yes, sir!
units.displayText: Sir, yes, sir!

spans.text: Sir, yes, sir!

units.rawText: Reporting, over the course of this week's training, we have three passes and eight terribles. As platoon leader, I am 80% responsible for this result. Please punish me, Instructor!
units.displayText: Reporting, over the course of this week's training, we have three passes and eight terribles. As platoon leader, I am 80% responsible for this result. Please punish me, Instructor!

spans.text: Reporting, over the course of this week's training, we have three passes and eight terribles. As platoon leader, I am 80% responsible for this result. Please punish me, Instructor!

units.rawText: Very good, it seems you fully understand your position. In that case, go P.T. yourselves according to the punishment guidelines I gave you earlier.
units.displayText: Very good, it seems you fully understand your position. In that case, go P.T. yourselves according to the punishment guidelines I gave you earlier.

spans.text: Very good, it seems you fully understand your position. In that case, go P.T. yourselves according to the punishment guidelines I gave you earlier.

units.rawText: Especially you, Evelyn. I like your smart mouth. Your rebuttal was well-reasoned and supported with evidence, so for that your punishment is doubled. Any questions!?
units.displayText: Especially you, Evelyn. I like your smart mouth. Your rebuttal was well-reasoned and supported with evidence, so for that your punishment is doubled. Any questions!?

spans.text: Especially you, Evelyn. I like your smart mouth. Your rebuttal was well-reasoned and supported with evidence, so for that your punishment is doubled. Any questions!?

units.rawText: Sir, no, sir!
units.displayText: Sir, no, sir!

spans.text: Sir, no, sir!

units.rawText: Then what the hell are you standing around for!?
units.displayText: Then what the hell are you standing around for!?

spans.text: Then what the hell are you standing around for!?

units.rawText: <size=40>Sir, yes, sir!</size>
units.displayText: Sir, yes, sir!

spans.text: Sir, yes, sir!

units.rawText: As he watches Erwin and Evelyn lead the rest of the group away, Python takes out his tactical tablet. The disdainful, harsh look on his face instantly vanishes and his brow furrows.

units.rawText: An "excellent" is a BASIC requirement for you! It's already appalling enough that you're not ashamed of not getting full marks, but how dare you start prattling about your ratings with a straight face!? The audacity!
